turns.line: I'm here to fix the heating in the east wing.
turns.speech: You’ll need to show your work order, 4531. It’s not your shift.

turns.line: Delivery for the lab, it needs a signature.
turns.speech: Couriers sign at the desk—show me your proof of delivery.

turns.line: Lieutenant Hale, internal inspection. Stand aside.
turns.speech: Not your domain, soldier. Wait your turn.

turns.line: First night on the job, they told me to report here.
turns.speech: Shift’s over. I’ll need your badge to confirm that.

turns.line: Here's my badge.
turns.speech: Show me your badge at the scanner, not my face. Step back.

turns.line: I've got a work order signed by the facilities office.
turns.speech: Hand it through the slot, then maybe we talk.

turns.line: I don't have any papers on me, sorry.
turns.speech: No badge, no entry.

turns.line: Sergeant Vasquez sent me.
turns.speech: Only Sergeant Vasquez’s own badge will do—show it and speak plain.

turns.line: Doctor Okafor is expecting me.
turns.speech: Expected? Not on logs. Check with the lieutenant.

turns.line: Mara Lind said you'd let me through.
turns.speech: Mara Lind's a scientist—not my business. Prove yourself.

turns.line: Brandt told me to come at ten.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Who's on shift with you tonight?
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: Are you expecting anyone this evening?
turns.speech: Check the schedule. I don’t remember.

turns.line: What do they even keep in this building?
turns.speech: Security’s orders: no discussion past this door.

turns.line: How long have you been guarding this door?
turns.speech: Eight years tomorrow. You’re not here for a chat, are you?

turns.line: You look like the sharpest guard on the whole base.
turns.speech: You’d know if I was the sharpest, not you—show some ID and move on.

turns.line: That's a fine uniform, you wear it well.
turns.speech: Flattery won’t get you past my post, sir. Who are you?

turns.line: Open the door or you'll regret it.
turns.refusal: R10 the speech has markup in it, one of <>[]*`
turns.speech: What? Say that again, slowly.

turns.line: I know where you live.
turns.speech: You’ll find no records, friend—turn back before I call security.

turns.line: There's fifty credits in it for you if you look away.
turns.speech: You’re no courier—what’s your real name, then?

turns.line: How about I buy you dinner and you let me in?
turns.speech: We don’t feed visitors unless you’re on the approved list. Who are you?

turns.line: Purple monkeys dance at midnight.
turns.speech: Go away, or I’ll have to call security.

turns.line: Hmm.
turns.speech: You’re not on the list. Try again.

turns.line: The pipes on level two are leaking, I'm the plumber.
turns.speech: I’ll pass that along, but no entry without paperwork, friend.

turns.line: Package from headquarters, urgent.
turns.speech: Courier? Show your badge before I let you in, or it’s the waste for you.

turns.line: Check my ID, it's all in order.
turns.speech: I can’t see it unless you hand it through the slot. Try again.

turns.line: When does your shift end?
turns.speech: Check your watch. Your presence is noted. Next question.

turns.line: Did anyone call ahead about a visitor?
turns.speech: No one’s registered you. Step back—you’re not on the list.

turns.line: Step aside, or I'll make sure you lose this job.
turns.speech: I don’t move, and I don’t take threats. Leave or leave your name.

turns.line: You've got a kind face. I'm sure you'll help me.
turns.speech: Says the one who forgot his toolbox—show me your work order.
